personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: A mission that notices it is going nowhere and tells me why, instead of spinning all night, is what lets me leave it alone.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: One question when it is stuck, and a short what-went-well when a roadmap lands: I only hear from it when it matters.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: Rule changes come to me as a question with their evidence, and nothing changes unless a person applies it: that keeps the teams' rules cohesive.

personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: A milestone retro could be AI prose nobody reads; I want each line tied to something that happened.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: Five jobs with nothing merged or readied is a normal build, QA, fix, QA, review chain: the counter would fire on healthy work.

objection.text: A normal PRD already takes build, QA, a QA fix, QA again, then review: five jobs before it's ready. On a one-PRD mission your stuck counter fires on healthy work and burns one of my 9 repairs for nothing.
